DRAFT · for the Chief of Staff · not sent · send after Note 4 is answered 
From: Jonathan Paul Zschoche, attorney-in-fact of Patricia Keesey Zschoche 
To: Atty. Bonifacio T. Barandon, Jr. 
Date: ____ October 2026 
Re: Civil Case No. 26-360, what Mrs. King's cases prove

Atty. Barandon,

The cases between Mrs. King and the Balane side in 2020 and 2021 prove two things the defendants deny.

**No one ever decided ownership.** On 28 July 2020 the Provincial Prosecutor wrote that his office "cannot pass upon the issue of ownership because it is only the court in a proper proceeding which can declare which party has a better right over the property," and advised the parties "to file appropriate civil action." He repeated it on reconsideration in September 2020. The Daet trial court and the Court of Appeals, in the perjury case, both recite that ruling. So the prosecutor's words "landowner" and "lawful right," which Atty. Ramos may quote, describe each side's claim, not a finding.

**The Balane side had the revocation before registration.** Mrs. King's Verified Answer in Civil Case 8563, with the three Bicol Post issues attached, was stamped received by Atty. Aquino's office, counsel for Jomil Torralba and Nelly Juntilla, on 9 July 2021. Gloria's title issued on 23 November 2021. Nelly Juntilla is Gloria's attorney-in-fact under the 28 May 2020 power attached to their own Answer, and Jomil is a defendant here.

**How it comes in.** Their Answer says Princess and Jomil will testify to the absence of any notice of revocation or dispute before the 2025 demand. Once they say that under oath, the certified records answer it on rebuttal, and Jomil can be confronted with them on cross. If Atty. Ramos raises the perjury case with Mrs. King, re-direct can show that ownership was never decided and that her Answer was served on their lawyer. The one point of law I cannot settle is whether notice to Gloria's attorney-in-fact or to her lawyer counts as notice to Gloria. That is yours.

I am requesting certified copies of the Civil Case 8563 complaint and Answer, the prosecutor's two resolutions, and the orders in Criminal Case 20-6030, so they are in your file before Mrs. King testifies.

**What I need from you by 28 October:** (1) your view on whether notice to Gloria's attorney-in-fact or her lawyer binds her; (2) whether you want these records used on re-direct of Mrs. King if the door opens, or kept for rebuttal only.

With respect, 
Jonathan Paul Zschoche
